title: Surreal Racing Dream
description: A vibrant surreal scene features a red Ferrari race car with number 07 driving through stormy clouds. Two large blue stylized female faces with orange flowers and green vines float in a purple sky above, flanking a set of black wind chimes, while two brown bulls charge through the clouds below.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with a bright red Ferrari race car numbered 07 speeding through purple stormy clouds and smoke. Two giant stylized blue female faces with orange flowers and flowing green vines emerge from the sky on left and right. Black wind chimes hang from a wooden structure in the center. Two powerful brown bulls with green accents charge through the clouds below. Dramatic purple and yellow sky, vibrant colors, dynamic composition, painterly style.
